svg.title: Mission brief — what I build
svg.desc: Left: an animated holographic blueprint of the ACS Intelligent Teams Bot architecture — Teams meeting to Azure Communication Services to Speech SDK, SignalR hub to a Blazor ops console, Azure OpenAI summaries to ServiceNow tickets, with OpenTelemetry tracing every hop. Right: four capabilities — AI-powered cloud plugins, secure enterprise backends, developer-productivity intelligence, and healthcare data and reporting.
